description: This file defines a Java interface named SubstitutionSource, which specifies methods for retrieving variable values (either as String or Object) and checking for variable existence, as well as getting all known keys. It is used for objects that provide variable/property values during substitution processes.

classes.name: SubstitutionSource
classes.description: Interface for objects that provide variable/property values to be used during substitution.

methods.name: hasStringVariable
methods.description: Checks if the source contains a variable identified by 'key' stored as a String.

methods.name: hasObjectVariable
methods.description: Checks if the source contains a variable identified by 'key' stored as a non-String Object.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Retrieves the String value for the specified variable 'key'. Only called if hasStringVariable() returns true.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves the Object value for the specified variable 'key'. Only called if hasObjectVariable() returns true.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns all of the keys that this source knows about.
